title: DO NOT BUY! FAIR WARNING
text:
DO NOT BUY! FAIR WARNING. Very cheap made!
As you can see in the pictures, the magnet slot could not even hold the weight of the magnet.
Easily torn, super thin.
MOST DEFINITELY NOT WORTH 10 BUCKS!
Save your money and go to the dollar store and pay 3 bucks for a much better one.lol

product_metadata.title: iDesign Vinyl Shower Liner, PVC-Free Curtain with Magnets for Master, Guest, Kids' Bathroom, Bathtub, Long, Clear
features: VERSATILE: Use this vinyl shower curtain liner alone or with a fabric shower curtain to keep water from splashing onto your bathroom floor. Great for master bathroom, guest bathroom, and kid's bathroom
GROMMETS: Encased magnets on bottom of curtain and 12 self-grommets are suitable for S hooks, shower rings, and other shower curtain hooks for easy hanging
DURABLE: Durable vinyl material is PVC-free for years of quality use
EASY CARE: Simply wipe with a damp cloth for a quick and easy clean
WIDE CURTAIN: Shower curtain liner measures 72" x 84", perfect for wider shower stalls
description: Upgrade your bathroom with the iDesign Shower Curtain Liner! The vinyl material is PVC-free . The curtain features encased magnets along the bottom and 12 self-grommets along the top header for easy hanging. Use alone or with a fabric shower curtain to keep water from splashing onto your bathroom floor. The classic clear finish matches perfectly with any decor. When it's time to refresh, simply wipe with a damp cloth to clean. The iDesign Shower Curtain Liner measures 72" x 84", perfect for your shower stall or bathtub. With iDesign by InterDesign, you can #LiveSimply every day.
